workbooks.title: Python Practice Workbook
workbooks.description: Realistic Python coding problems drawn from data and AI engineering work: logs, API payloads, model predictions, token usage and RAG pipelines. Each question has a precise spec, three progressive hints, automated checks and a hidden reference solution, plus a timed Testing Mode and progress tracking.
workbooks.shortDescription: Realistic data and AI engineering problems with hints, automated tests and hidden reference solutions.
workbooks.includes: Jupyter notebook, a Python practice system (src/) and 13 small sample datasets
workbooks.requirements: Python 3.10+ and Jupyter. Questions use only the standard library.

workbooks.title: NumPy Practice Workbook
workbooks.description: Practise NumPy on a synthetic Smart Factory sensor network with missing readings, fault spikes and anomalies. A learning phase introduces concepts, a testing phase makes you choose the right operation yourself, and a final challenge builds a factory health dashboard. Hints and solutions are on request.
workbooks.shortDescription: Practise NumPy on a synthetic factory sensor dataset, from guided tasks to a final dashboard challenge.
workbooks.includes: Jupyter notebook and practice_system.py, which generates the dataset and serves hints and solutions

workbooks.title: Pandas Practice Workbook
workbooks.description: Work through guided Pandas exercises, then an independent testing phase that doesn't tell you which function to use, and finish with an end-to-end customer value and retention report. Includes debugging, merge auditing, performance and interview-style problems, with hints and full solutions.
workbooks.shortDescription: Guided, then independent Pandas challenges, ending in an end-to-end customer retention report.
workbooks.includes: Jupyter notebook, practice_system.py and 5 CSV datasets in data/

workbooks.title: SQL Practice Workbook
workbooks.description: SQL practice for Data Scientists, ML Engineers and AI Engineers on a 32-table SaaS dataset with product analytics, billing, an ML churn model and LLM/RAG data. Every question has three hints, expected output, a solution and an explanation, validated on both PostgreSQL and MySQL.
workbooks.shortDescription: SQL for data and AI roles on a 32-table SaaS dataset, validated on PostgreSQL and MySQL.
workbooks.includes: Jupyter notebook, setup scripts for both databases, CSV data and solution files
workbooks.requirements: A local PostgreSQL 16+ or MySQL 8.0+ database. Python is optional.

roadmaps.title: The Machine Learning Roadmap
roadmaps.description: A step-by-step path from Python fundamentals to real-world ML projects: what to learn first, how much math you need, which algorithms matter, how to evaluate models honestly and how to deploy one. Every stage ends with a practice task and a readiness checkpoint.
roadmaps.shortDescription: A step-by-step path from Python basics to real ML projects.
roadmaps.includes: Roadmap flowchart, algorithm guides, 4 project briefs, a 12-week sample plan, progress checklists and 17 checked learning resources
